channel.title: Clive · Journal
channel.description: What Clive is building, teaching and learning.

item.title: Vaqt 2: a bazaar, levels and 55 awards
item.description: Vaqt grew up on day one. Twenty plants in five rarity tiers, golden variants, a Bazaar with decorations and sceneries, levels with titles, three daily quests, 55 awards from bronze to diamond, and a dial whose sky follows the time of day.

item.title: The Clive orbit and Vaqt go live
item.description: Everything I make now lives in one place, in three languages. And there’s a new planet: Vaqt, a focus timer and time tracker that grows an Uzbek garden while you work.

item.title: Dilnura Edu, on the Class engine
item.description: A class site for another teacher’s Navigate A1 group, built from my ClivEdu Class engine, with a teacher dashboard, payments table, room planner and a Telegram bot.

item.title: I started learning German
item.description: No education centre and no hunting for YouTube lessons. I’m learning with my own app, Sprachwerk, starting from the Sound Lab.

item.title: Sprachwerk: slide lessons and sync
item.description: Grammar decks in ClivEdu style (formula, colour-coded examples, a “Warum?” slide) and Google sign-in that merges progress between devices instead of overwriting it.

item.title: A new Beginner group
item.description: A slow-paced group for students who know no English yet, on Mondays and Thursdays from 15:30, with Uzbek in every lesson.

item.title: clivedu.me now opens the classroom
item.description: My domain points to ClivEdu Class, the site my students open on their phones in every lesson.

item.title: Technical Issues Q&A eBook
item.description: 60 everyday tech problems, each on one page with a diagram and a numbered fix. 78 pages, on Whop.

item.title: ClivEdu Class opens with Big Revision
item.description: The class site’s first lesson: sentences, to be, questions and commands. Sixteen lessons later, my groups follow every class on it.

item.title: My Whop store opens
item.description: A home for the digital products I make, under the name Digital Products.

item.title: TM HOTEL: an honest availability calendar
item.description: The hotel updates it by hand, and the site stays what it should be: information and availability, no fake bookings.

item.title: Vault Studio for WonderVault
item.description: A browser studio to write, edit and thumbnail amazing-facts videos, on my phone or my computer.

item.title: Frans Burger
item.description: A burger and coffee shop site with builders for burgers, coffee, shawarma and hot dogs, and orders that land in the shop’s Telegram.

item.title: RIVA HOTEL and Robiya mebellari
item.description: Two Andijan businesses, two sites in three languages: a calm hotel and a furniture store whose rooms furnish themselves.

item.title: ClivEdu: English among the stars
item.description: A personal English classroom with a Word Galaxy that grows with every word, games, homework and a teacher desk.
